name: Account
definition: A bank account identified by fld001. An account carries a statement issuance frequency (fld003), an opening date (fld004), and a district affiliation (fld002). It is the hub that links clients, loans, and transactions.
scope: Account-level analysis in the financial database; all account-related questions use tab01 as the account entity.

name: Client
definition: A bank customer identified by fld009, with a gender (fld010), a birth date (fld011), and a residence district (fld002).
scope: Client-level analysis; clients relate to accounts through disposition records rather than through a direct foreign key on the account.

name: Account Disposition
definition: A disposition record linking one client to one account and assigning the client's role on that account (OWNER or DISPONENT). It is the association record between clients and accounts.
scope: Client-to-account attribution. Each account has exactly one OWNER disposition; additional clients can hold DISPONENT dispositions.

name: District
definition: A district (administrative unit) identified by fld002, with a name (fld012), a region (fld013), and demographic and economic attributes such as average salary (fld021).
scope: District-level reference data. Both accounts and clients reference districts, but through separate columns that carry different meanings.

name: Loan
definition: A loan facility granted against an account, with an approved amount, an approval date, a duration in months, and a contract status.
scope: Loan-level analysis in tab06; each loan row belongs to one account.

name: Transaction
definition: A posting on an account with a date, a debit/credit type, an operation kind, and an amount.
scope: Transaction-level analysis in tab08; each transaction belongs to one account.

name: Statement Issuance Frequency
definition: The statement issuance schedule chosen for an account, recorded as a coded text value: monthly issuance (POPLATEK MESICNE), weekly issuance (POPLATEK TYDNE), or issuance after transaction (POPLATEK PO OBRATU).
scope: Account-level attribute used for filters such as 'weekly issuance statement', 'monthly statement issuance', or 'issuance after transaction'.

name: Account Opening Date
definition: The date on which an account was opened (tab01.fld004). Its year is what questions refer to as 'accounts in 1993' or 'account opening date in 1993'.
scope: Account-level date dimension.

name: Client Gender
definition: The client's gender, recorded as 'F' (female) or 'M' (male).
scope: Client-level attribute; 'women' and 'female' both refer to code 'F', and 'men' and 'male' both refer to code 'M'.

name: Client Birth Date
definition: The client's date of birth (tab03.fld011), used to identify clients born on a specific date or in a specific year.
scope: Client-level date dimension.

name: District Name
definition: The human-readable name of a district (tab05.fld012), for example Hl.m. Praha or Benesov. A request for a 'district name' refers to this column, not to the region column.
scope: District-level attribute.

name: Region
definition: The region in which a district lies (tab05.fld013). Eight English region names are stored: Prague, central Bohemia, south Bohemia, west Bohemia, north Bohemia, east Bohemia, south Moravia, and north Moravia.
scope: District-level attribute; region-level analysis aggregates districts and, through them, accounts and clients.

name: District Average Salary
definition: The average salary recorded for a district (tab05.fld021), stored as an integer attached to each district. It is a district-level economic attribute, not a client-level or account-level value.
scope: District-level metric; salary-based conditions evaluate the district that the account or client is associated with.

name: Loan Approval Date
definition: The date on which a loan was approved (tab06.fld004). Questions referring to an 'approved loan date in 1997' or to a loan approval window use this column.
scope: Loan-level date dimension.

name: Loan Duration
definition: The loan's validity or term in months (tab06.fld029), stored as an integer per loan. 'Loan validity more than 12 months' is a numeric condition on this value.
scope: Loan-level metric.

name: Loan Status
definition: The contract status code of a loan (tab06.fld031). Observed values are A, B, C, and D. The construction workload documents 'C' as a running contract that is OK so far, which is the meaning of 'still running with no issue'.
scope: Loan-level status. Meanings of A, B, and D are not documented by the construction workload and must not be assumed.

name: Approved Loan Amount
definition: The amount approved for a loan, recorded per loan in tab06.fld028. Questions refer to it as 'approved amount' or 'loan amount'.
scope: Loan-level metric. The same column name, fld028, holds an order amount in tab07 and a transaction amount in tab08, so the table context must be respected.

name: Transaction Operation
definition: The operation kind of a transaction (tab08.fld037), for example VYBER (withdrawal in cash), VKLAD, PREVOD NA UCET, PREVOD Z UCTU, or VYBER KARTOU. The column is NULL for many credit transactions.
scope: Transaction-level category. The workload documents fld037 = 'VYBER' as withdrawal in cash.

name: Transaction Type
definition: The debit/credit direction of a transaction (tab08.fld007), with observed values PRIJEM, VYDAJ, and VYBER.
scope: Transaction-level category. The column name fld007 is also used in tab04 (OWNER/DISPONENT) and tab02 (classic/gold/junior) with unrelated value domains.

name: Transaction Date
definition: The date on which a transaction was posted (tab08.fld004).
scope: Transaction-level date dimension.

name: Transaction Amount
definition: The monetary amount of a transaction recorded in tab08.fld028.
scope: Transaction-level metric; not to be confused with the loan amount or the permanent-order amount stored under the same column name in other tables.

name: Disposition Role
definition: The role of a client on an account, recorded in tab04.fld007 as OWNER (the account owner) or DISPONENT (a client with disposition rights).
scope: Disposition-level category. This domain is unrelated to the transaction type domain that shares the column name fld007.

name: Percentage Share
definition: A part-to-whole ratio expressed as a percentage. It is computed from a numerator count of entities that satisfy a condition and a denominator count of the reference population.
scope: Used by questions asking 'what percentage of ...'. The metric is a ratio and is not additive across groups.
